# hdr-glow

Make colors brighter than white on HDR screens, entirely in the browser.
Upload a logo, pick the colors that should glow, and download an HDR JPEG
(gain map) for the web and Apple Photos, or a Rec.2100 PQ JPEG for LinkedIn.
The JPEG encoder, the gain-map container, and the ICC profile are all
written from scratch in TypeScript; nothing is uploaded, everything runs in
this page. A text demo shows the same trick with `background-clip: text`.
